Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight to make their own food from water and carbon dioxide.
The green pigment called chlorophyll absorbs light energy, and this energy is then used to drive the chemical reactions in the leaf.
Oxygen is released as a by product, which is one of the main reasons why plants are so important for life on our planet.
